title: CSI TBC — Tab Clear
summary: CSI Ps g clears tab stops: Ps=0 (default) clears the tab stop at the current column; Ps=3 clears all tab stops.

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: the CSI sequence ends at its final byte.

params.name: Clear current tab stop
params.meaning: CSI 0 g (or CSI g) clears the tab stop at the current column.
params.byte_sequence_ST_readable: ESC [ g (clear tab stop at cursor)

params.name: Clear all tab stops
params.meaning: CSI 3 g clears all tab stops.

gotchas: After clearing all tab stops, TAB (0x09) may not advance the cursor (or advances to the screen edge).
Re-set default 8-column tabs with CSI 8 ; 0 ; 0 ; 0 ; 0 t (DECST8C) in some terminals.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: CSI sequence renders as a byte-exact sequence with final byte 'g'.
